title: Porsche Kat 090 Literaturkatalog
notes: Official literature catalogue identifies the German 993 Carrera and Turbo repair-manual and OBD-II publication references. It is an index, not the workshop manuals themselves. 2026-10-15 (issue #10): the only readable new-stock listing found for the English set WKD 483 121 is SRC-STODDARD-993-WORKSHOP-MANUAL-WKD483121; no listing of the German WKD483110 was found, and no vendor read on that date offers volume V on its own or gives it a separate reference. Search-engine snippets mention dealer listings WKD-483-130, -140 and -150 titled 'Workshop Manual 911 (993)'; those pages returned 403 and the snippets do not tie any number to a single volume, so none is recorded as the volume V reference.
